desc: Fix taaWorldResolve (c-engine/renderer/diligent/TaaDiligent.cpp:1312). Add a TAA-off branch guarded by !taaOn && postFXContext && cameraCB && ssaoReady() && ssaoOn(). CRITICAL: ssaoExecute is a DEPENDENT pass - it silently returns PENDING (no-op, ssaoRan stays false, composite skipped) unless PostFXContext::Execute has run first (the only place IsPSOsReady() is set and the blue-noise texture is filled), and the TAA-off path never calls it. So the TAA-off branch MUST build PostFXContext::RenderAttributes pa identically to the TAA-on block (lines 1324-1330: device, ctx, cameraCB, depthTex[curr]/depthTex[prev] default SRVs with curr=frameIdx&1 prev=(frameIdx+1)&1, motionTex SRV), call postFXContext->Execute(pa), then under a Diligent::ScopedDebugGroup(ctx,"ssao") do ssaoRan = ssaoExecute(ctx, taaDepthSRV(curr)). The existing AO-composite guard at line 1369 (ssaoOn() && ssaoRan) then fires unchanged. Leave the TAA-on block (lines 1320-1353) byte-identical. Remove the stale 'TAA off / pending' clause from the AO-composite comment (lines ~1363-1368) since SSAO now runs with TAA off (do not add new comments). No shader/PSO/texture/DiligentRenderer.cpp changes.

Build via the pinned verification's run.sh path (build.sh is called from it) and confirm a clean compile: no C++ errors in /tmp/ao_taa_off.log, no 'ssao'/'aoComposite' PSO or shader warnings at startup, and the 'taa: targets' info line present.

Run the pinned Verification command from plan.md and require exit code 0: the TAA-off + AO-on frame must be measurably darker than the TAA-off + AO-off frame (mean diff > 0 and >1% of pixels differ by more than 3/255). Inspect /tmp/ao_taa_off.png visually: AO darkening visible in crevices/under geometry, not a uniform full-screen dim, no black screen or artifacts.

Regression, TAA on: repeat the screenshot run with taaEnabled=true, aoDisabled=false (e.g. /tmp/ao_taa_on.png) and confirm AO still applies with TAA on (compare against a taaEnabled=true, aoDisabled=true baseline: same darkening check as task 3). The TAA-on code path must be unchanged — diff the file to prove only the TAA-off branch and comment changed.

Edge checks in the TAA-off path: (a) first frame (frameIdx continuity) and (b) window resize while TAA off (createTargets recreation, aoCompositeTex sized with the target) do not crash or produce a black frame — verify in /tmp/ao_taa_off.log that no new warnings appear and the screenshot path still passes. Note: ssaoFrameBegin/ssaoExecute must not depend on taaOn or on the TAA Execute having run.
